summary: Implemented all 8 plan phases for the gate-ceiling-fit-and-stall-detection work: Gate 8's slow-cost-class bucket was relocated to a new serialized gate 31, bringing Gate 8's own measured wall-clock to 349s (under the 600s foreground ceiling with ~42% headroom, measured twice under real non-idle load). The advisory batch-gate-deferral directive was replaced with a staleness-bounded marker plus mechanical entry guards in verify-deploy.sh/run-all.sh; contention tagging was generalized to every gate's timeout-kill path; and a dispatch watchdog now launches beside Move 2's Agent calls to detect a silent dispatch without waiting for every call to return. Phase 8 closed with exclusions: three pre-existing, unrelated full-gate-set findings are Reasoned-Excluded in the plan's own Phase 8 section.

artifacts.summary: Full implementation summary with the measured Gate 8 headroom, the coverage statement, and the Reasoned Exclusions.
8-phase plan, all phases now checked off with completion annotations and deviation notes; Phase 8 carries its own Reasoned Exclusions table.
